artworks.label: Tufted Saturn pillow
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone square1024x1024 Glaze small-widget illustration for moonmallow. One adorable small Saturn-shaped pillow illustrated as dense punch-needle wool tufting and soft low-relief embroidered contours: rounded pale-lilac planet with two tiny cocoa sleepy eyes, thick warm-cream tilted ring, one little buttery-yellow star stitched near its edge. Fine visible looped yarn tufts, soft fuzzy fibres, sophisticated textile craft photography, muted lilac/cream/yellow against dark plum-blue reflected shadows. No crochet loops, no koala, moon crescent, comet, cloud swing or nest. Whole subject centered, compact readable silhouette, generous18percent empty margins. Truly transparent empty background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, floor, frame, border or collage. Pure illustration only: absolutely no text, lettering, numerals, dates, clocks, hands, dials, calendars, UI, logos or watermark. Entirely new art, never copy/crop/recolour an existing image.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q90 method4; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
